definition: to designate a place with a mark
description: Two rangers in matching khaki uniforms work on green coastal hills. They spread a white map over the bonnet of their truck and study it, then carry wooden stakes topped with orange flags up the slope and push them into the ground one after another, so that a line of orange flags curves over the ridge. An aerial shot shows the finished flag line running across the hillside down towards the sea, and one ranger steps back, takes off her hat and looks along it.

de.answer: Sie markiert eine Linie mit orangefarbenen Fähnchen.
de.question: Was macht die Frau?

es.answer: Está marcando una línea con banderines naranjas.
